title: New storage blocks
body:
New storage blocks have been added: Cupboards, Drawers, Treasure Chests and Duffle Bags.

* Cupboards and Treasure Chests are nothing special. Treasure Chests simply mark better loot in structures and can't be crafted
* Drawers act like slabs: one has half the storage of a single chest, and a second in the same space brings it up to a full chest
* Duffle Bags can be carried with both hands without the items falling out. Portable storage! They have fewer slots, though, and you can't use other items while carrying one. Breaking a bag makes the items fall out
